_about: Words for a home-page card that its descriptor does not give (the user's decision, 2026-09-30): a card's Bengali title where it differs from its page's (titleBn), and an optional one-line caption (captionBn). tools/build-registry.mjs merges them into docs/registry.json — title.bn replaced, caption { bn } added — and tools/verify.mjs holds every entry here to a finished map or diagram of the same kind, the caption to one line of Bengali. A card with no entry here is its descriptor's, with no caption.
